headline: Eleven requests to change city staff positions, including a new Deputy HR Director and a grade change for the Independent City Auditor.
summary: The agenda also includes a SmartShopper report for the third quarter of 2026, provided for information only. Other items cover staffing in police, public health, and water works.
items: SmartShopper report for the third quarter of 2026, for information only
Planning and Community Development: add one full-time Business Services Manager (grade 120) and eliminate one full-time Office Manager (grade 117)
Welfare: change one full-time Welfare Specialist I from grade 108 to grade 110, eliminate one part-time Accounting Technician II (grade 107), and add one part-time Accountant I (grade 108)
Police: create two part-time Police Officer positions (grade 117) for a new staffing initiative pilot program
Finance: add one full-time Finance Manager - Treasury (grade 124) and eliminate one full-time Accountant I (grade 108)
EPD division: add one full-time Administrative Assistant I (grade 104) and eliminate one full-time Accounting Technician I (grade 104)
Parks, Recreation & Cemetery: add one full-time Irrigation Designer (grade 110) and change the Vegetation Specialist position from grade 106 to grade 107
Public Health: add one full-time Community Health Nurse II (grade 118), add two full-time Environmental Health Technicians (grade 108), and amend the Community Health Nurse I class specification
Water Works: add one full-time Water Distribution Engineer (grade 121) and eliminate one full-time Water Distribution Manager (grade 118)
Solicitor: change the Independent City Auditor position to grade 130
Human Resources: add one full-time Deputy HR Director (grade 127)
plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON HUMAN RESOURCES/INSURANCE 
November 17, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen Goonan, Sapienza, O'Neil, Burkush, Vincent 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. SmartShopper Report for the third quarter of 2026. 
(Note: Provided for informational purposes only; no action is required.) 
    
2. Communication from Jeff Belanger, Planning and Community Development 
Director, requesting the following changes to the department's complement: 
• Add one (1) full-time Business Services Manager, grade 120; 
• Eliminate one (1) full-time Office Manager, grade 117. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
3. Communication from Charleen Michaud, Welfare Director, requesting the 
following changes to the department's complement: 
• Modify one (1) current full-time Welfare Specialist I position from a grade 
108 to a grade 110; 
• Eliminate one (1) part-time Accounting Technician II position, grade 107; 
• Add one (1) part-time Accountant I position, grade 108. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
4. Communication from Ken Loui, Assistant Chief of Police, requesting the 
creation and addition of two (2) part-time Police Officer positions, grade 117, to 
the department's complement as part of a new staffing initiative pilot program.  
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure?
November 17, 2026 COMMITTEE ON HUMAN RESOURCES/INSURANCE 
Page 2 of 2 
 
 
5. Communication from Sharon Wickens, Finance Officer, requesting the following 
changes to the department's complement: 
• Add one (1) full-time Finance Manager - Treasury position, grade 124; 
• Eliminate one (1) full-time Accountant I position, grade 108. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
6. Communication from Robert Robinson, EPD Chief Engineer, requesting the 
following changes to the division's complement: 
• Add one (1) full-time Administrative Assistant I position, grade 104; 
• Eliminate one (1) full-time Accounting Technician I position, grade 104. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
7. Communication from Mark Gomez, Chief of Parks, Recreation & Cemetery, 
requesting the following changes to the division's complement: 
• Addition of one (1) new full-time Irrigation Designer position, grade 110; 
• Amend the Vegetation Specialist position from a grade 106 to a grade 
107. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure?  
    
8. Communication from Anna Thomas, Public Health Director, requesting the 
following changes to the department's complement: 
• Add one (1) new full-time Community Health Nurse II position, grade 118; 
• Add two (2) new full-time Environmental Health Technician positions, 
grade 108; 
• Amend the Community Health Nurse I position class spec content 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
9. Communication from Phil Croasdale, Water Works Director, requesting the 
following changes to the department's complement: 
• Add one (1) new full-time Water Distribution Engineer position, grade 
121; 
• Eliminate one (1) full-time Water Distribution Manager position, grade 
118. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
10. Communication from Emily Rice, Solicitor, requesting the Independent City 
Auditor position be modified to a grade 130. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
11. Communication from Jamie Corwin, Human Resources Director, requesting the 
addition of one (1) new full-time Deputy HR Director position, grade 127, to the 
department's complement. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
